closed_inputs.paths: Only the fixed canonical transport root derived from RUNNER_TOOL_CACHE/new allocation/current decimal run_id; every component must meet pretransmission_path_policy.literal_alphabet and no-follow ownership/seal checks. Canonicality alone is insufficient.
closed_inputs.plan: a <=4096-byte fixed scalar upload-plan.txt is emitted/read back within the existing preservation600 deadline, outside the raw archive but counted in bounded preservation output; records part_count1..3 and original manifest bytes/hash. Composite builtin-only validation checks exact fixed identity and literal names; it neither packages nor discovers files. The plan and selected sources must also satisfy the prospective literal/no-follow/read-only seal policy before any vendor action.

manifest_binding: Transport manifest is generated only after the raw archive is sealed and split. It binds exact archive bytes/hash/format, complete ordered part names/sizes/hashes, and raw evidence inventory. It is not a member of the raw archive and contains no own-hash/self-size field. First provider wrapper carries its exact original bytes; canonical Drive manifest upload and independent fresh readback must equal those extracted bytes. Manifest is separate metadata, never appended to or substituted for part-001.bin.

pretransmission_path_policy.composite_before_each_vendor_step: Inside the one60s composite, before any selected vendor upload, use only bounded fixed builtin checks/read of the <=4096-byte plan: exact derived ASCII path, each component non-symlink, fixed directories still directories/private-owned, plan and selected payloads regular/non-symlink/readable/owned/read-only, exact ordinal/count and fixed literal file names. Reject unavailable/inconsistent observations before that vendor action. Supply only exact file paths as separate controlled lines, never a directory, wildcard, user-provided path, or uploaded plan itself. No hashing, copying, repackaging, source repair or permission resealing occurs after preservation expires.
pretransmission_path_policy.early_gate: Apply literal-cache/path eligibility in the zero-evaluator shared startup before science; reject a canonical but glob-bearing cache root rather than discovering that limitation after evaluation.
pretransmission_path_policy.literal_alphabet: Every full derived upload/plan path must match ASCII ^/[A-Za-z0-9._/-]+$ under LC_ALL=C, with nonempty components and no . or .. component, repeated separator, trailing separator or alias. No whitespace/control byte, backslash, tilde, dollar, wildcard, bracket, brace, parenthesis, plus, exclamation or other glob/control syntax is permitted. Fixed filenames and decimal run_id are the only suffixes.
pretransmission_path_policy.ownership_and_TOCTOU_limit: The reviewed custody model trusts the runner account and frozen source. Unique private namespace, confirmed shutdown of owned writers, read-only seal and no subsequent authorized writer bound the validation-to-read interval. The vendor still opens paths later and follows links internally; there is no claim of OS-atomic fd transfer or protection against arbitrary malicious concurrent same-UID/root mutation. If exclusive custody or unchanged sealed state cannot be established, no upload is attempted. Any observed post-seal change blocks further uploads and successful custody; it does not undo a prior transmission or authorize retry.
pretransmission_path_policy.postdownload_checks: All existing exact member, type, duplicate/traversal, expansion, CRC/hash and independent canonical readback gates remain mandatory. These are additional acceptance checks, never substitutes for pretransmission selection safety.
pretransmission_path_policy.sealing_within_preservation: Within the SAME original600 deadline, before declaring upload_ready, validate canonical fixed transport root and every path component with no-follow metadata checks. Require runner-owned private allocation/transport directories, no writable-by-other-user/group custody parents, exact selected regular single-link files and plan, no symlinks or special files, exact manifest/part byte limits and full source hashes. All owned admission/coordinator/cell/preservation writers must have finished or positively transferred custody; unknown cleanup/writer ownership prevents upload readiness. Persist the existing hash/stat/ownership proof, finish and fsync files, and seal transport payload files/plan read-only0400 and transport directory0500. Ancestors retain existing private custody permissions; no system-directory permissions are changed.

remaining_gates: Two full amendment reviews, root adoption/preregistration supplement, bounded implementation, exact source/fixture map, native gate, full source review and CI/freeze/GO as already required.
scope: One fixed local composite groups the existing provider uploads under one existing same-job60-second timeout. Explicit first wrapper includes original compact transport manifest. No scientific/resource change, new job, cache-internal invocation, custom HTTP uploader or separate readiness allocation.
status: proposal only, awaiting both independent reviews and root prospective adoption; no workflow/composite implementation authorized by this file
timeout_custody: Single outer composite timeout initializes once; nested children inherit remaining time in observed runner source. No embedded step may use always() to continue upload after timeout/failure. One failed/cancelled/late or absent upload leaves custody incomplete; retain every confirmed artifact ID and raw durable prefix. Platform cancellation is not claimed instantaneous. Parent verifies actual composite start/end and outcome; no success claim for an observed interval>=60s or unknown/cancelled completion, even if an artifact subsequently appears. No repack/retry/replacement or further science follows.
unchanged_provider_operations: At most3 logical artifact-wrapper downloads,3 canonical part uploads plus1 compact manifest upload, each fresh canonical readback. No fourth provider artifact needed. Existing source/runtime/science/397-method native limits remain unchanged.

workflow.condition: fixed local preservation upload-ready proof exists; first admission scope unchanged; a computational failure may preserve sealed incomplete evidence, but cannot claim scientific success
workflow.global_wall: same existing45-minute job contains checkout/startup/measurement/preservation/composite and internal step delays; no second-job scheduling interval or fresh global anchor. Existing original phase clocks remain authoritative.
workflow.retry: none at logical wrapper/action/attempt level; no overwrite or rearm; vendor-internal behavior does not create a new allowed window
workflow.upload_action_runtime: node20 (same official action runtime; never a scientific interpreter)

wrapper_validation: Require exact ordinal-specific member set, no duplicate names, traversal, absolute paths, directory/symlink/special entries, encryption or unsupported methods; check declared and actual expanded lengths, every CRC, exact manifest bytes/strict JSON/schema and all part/archive/inventory bindings. Later wrappers may not contain any manifest. Original part bytes/hash are unchanged. Actual downloaded outer ZIP size remains independently checked <32MiB; overhead is not guessed away.
